fusions.name: Mocking Fling
fusions.desc: Flings a clod that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to turn it against its allies for 3 seconds. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Pilfered Finish
fusions.desc: A finishing blow that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Troop Bluff
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies within 5 tiles for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 10% faster while veiled, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Feint and Wallop
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
